ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; the visible surface is approximately 92% low-intensity (dark/black) pixels and 8% high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated at the distal extremities.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white pixel clusters are localized at the far distal tips of both lobes and along the lower trailing margins. The central and upper fluke regions consist of a uniform, low-intensity dark contiguous block.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped depression at the center, with an approximate pixel angle of 48 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending roughly 15% into the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations observed across both lobes, characterized by approximately 10-14 distinct peaks per lobe with pixel-amplitudes varying between 5 and 20 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: A smooth convex curve characterizes the outer edges, transitioning into a concave sweep along the trailing edge toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (barnacle colonization) are clearly mapped to the extreme terminal points of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple faint, unaligned vertical linear pixel disruptions are visible on the medial-right lobe surface, appearing as thin, high-intensity gray scratches against the dark background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified barnacle encrustations creating a textured, high-relief topography on the distal tips of both lobes.
